stem.text: A sledge of mass $50\,\text{kg}$ sits on a snowy surface. It is pulled horizontally for $10\,\text{m}$ against a frictional force of $200\,\text{N}$, then it is pulled horizontally across ice for $10\,\text{m}$. There is no friction between the ice and the sledge. It is lifted up vertically by $1\,\text{m}$ and finally carried back at a constant speed to where it started.
During which stage of its journey is most work done on the sledge?

A.text: being carried back $20\,\text{m}$ at constant speed
